per_candidate.id: s2:Nuclear Pasta in Cold Non-Accreting Neutron Stars: Symmetry Energy Effects

supporting_ids: s2:Nuclear Pasta in Cold Non-Accreting Neutron Stars: Symmetry Energy Effects
rationale: Papers 2309.01591 and s2:Nuclear Pasta in Cold Non-Accreting Neutron Stars: Symmetry Energy Effects directly investigate the role of the energy functional and symmetry energy in the pasta phases of neutron stars. They provide evidence that the influence of the symmetry energy is significantly weakened, suggesting the premise of the question is weakened.
